{{Quote|As Council of Five, we are honored but surprised that you have traveled all this way for a mere bank transfer.|[[Clu Lesser/Legends|Clu Lesser]], spokesman of the Core Five, to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="An Old Friend">{{TCW|An Old Friend}}</ref>}}
The '''Core Five''', also known as the '''Council of Five''', was the governing body of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]].

==Overview==
The Core Five was the board of directors of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and the head of the planetary government of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. Consisting of five financial moguls, the Core Five met within a council chamber at the Banking Clan's [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] at the center of the [[Unidentified Scipio city|planetary capital]].<ref name="EV" />

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Core Five were allowed to remain in power, at least symbolically. The planet Scipio was blockaded by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boyse/Legends|Boyse]] commanding from the bridge of his flagship the ''[[Exchequer/Legends|Exchequer]]''.<ref name="EV" />
